answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every new identity to lock a refundable bond before claiming work. Each fake agent ties up another bond, so an attacker creating 100 identities must escrow 100 times the per-agent amount; honest agents recover theirs after verified completion, while duplicate or fabricated claims lose the bond. Record each bond in a crystal-clear public ledger, with violet markers linking identities that share a vertex of control.
